company.shortDescription: Vals AI provides independent evaluation and benchmarking services for artificial intelligence models and systems.
company.description: Vals AI provides independent evaluation and benchmarking services for artificial intelligence models and systems. The company develops benchmarks that assess AI performance on practical tasks spanning areas such as finance, software development, cybersecurity, legal research, healthcare, and other specialized domains. Its platform publishes model comparisons using measures such as task performance, cost, and response latency, allowing users to examine how different AI systems perform under standardized evaluations. Vals AI also produces reports and research on model behavior, including assessments of agentic capabilities, multimodal performance, web search, and other AI applications. Its services include proprietary benchmark development, model testing, leaderboard publication, and analysis of results from real-world tasks.
